description: List roots this server can access and its read-only directories. Use for allowed paths or after ACCESS_DENIED. Do not use it to browse; use `list`, `find_files`, or `stat` instead. Accepted grants add roots; call again after one. Outside paths prompt a grant only on elicitation clients, never for home, system paths, or anything outside FS_ROOT_BOUNDARY. Returns absolute { roots, readOnlyDirs (writes, moves, deletes refused), hint? when roots is empty }.
name: list_roots
title: Workspace Roots
